en.html: Patriarch"Some orphan that fellow Akitaka picked up from somewhere and brought into the Minato house—that is you. We raised you. Don't forget the debt. Make yourself useful to this clan, as much as you can."
en.text: Patriarch"Some orphan that fellow Akitaka picked up from somewhere and brought into the Minato house—that is you. We raised you. Don't forget the debt. Make yourself useful to this clan, as much as you can."

ja.html: 本家「貴様はあの明堯めが何処やらで拾ってきて 湊斗の家に入れた身無し子だ。 　養育の恩を忘れず、せいぜい我が一族の為 に尽くすがいい」
ja.text:
本家「貴様はあの明堯めが何処やらで拾ってきて
湊斗の家に入れた身無し子だ。
　養育の恩を忘れず、せいぜい我が一族の為
に尽くすがいい」
